model: TUDOR Pelagos 39 M25407N-0001 (39 mm titanium, black dial, three-column titanium bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Pelagos 39 template (copy of the Black Bay 58 structure with its own measurements): case with crown-guard shoulder, bezel (black insert + titanium coin edge), crown, hands and the three-column bracelet from the 39 mm photo; the dial, indices, print and minute track come from one 2x photo map with the photographed hands left in it. Later Pelagos 39 variants change model, note, trace, dial_map, steel_map, emissions and whatever differs.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug tops y 291 / bottoms y 908); top slopes toward the bracelet; the crown-guard shoulder above the crown (right edge x 735) comes from the silhouette

bezel.note: steel coin-edge ring (bezel_in..bezel_out) around the black insert (bezel_in..insert_out); numerals, markers and triangle come from the projected photo

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, measured on the photo (rows along each axis at 1 px, minute hand to s 145 then constant; seconds diamond from row runs) plus 0.03 mm so the 3D hands hide the photographed ones; the last point sits at the traced length. lume = +w side outline [s, w] of the lume polygon, mirrored about the axis (hour: stem strip + square-shouldered diamond with the nub, minute: strip with a square end, seconds: diamond). The seconds profile starts with the 5.9 px half-width counterweight bar behind the hub. Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: Pelagos 39 crown from the photo: x 713..763, y 551..643; fluted part to x 751, rounded end cap to 763; the shoulder above it is part of the case outline

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Flat three-column titanium bracelet (outer, centre, outer, 39 mm Pelagos). Joints read from the photo with brightness-step scans and 3x crops, top and bottom separately (13.8872 px/mm, pivot (449, 594)): outer top y 202 / 140 (end 129), bottom 1013 / 1091.5 (end 1121.5); centre top 246.5 / 166, bottom 875 / 961 / 1056.5 / 1112.5 (end 1122). The centre column starts at 18 mm under the bezel's coin ring. bounds_x_mm = the two vertical joint lines between the columns, [|y|, x1, x2] (top x 381.7 / 516.6, bottom 382.5 / 517.4 px). Outer link edges come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
